5909.title: Sidebar Archive alignment changes around inline disclosure
5909.rootCauseOneLine: Title-following disclosure triggers margin before the trailing menu, shifting Archive 28 px and leaving a 2 px gap.
5909.proposedFix: Keep trailing actions stable and separate disclosure hit targets; review the already-open PR 5910 instead of opening a duplicate.
5909.caveats: Desktop hover/pointer CSS predicates were emulated for the headless browser. No destructive archive action or submitted PR code was executed. The test and fixture patch are embedded in the HTML; raw artifacts remain local.
